_method_note: STATE-MH-LANE REPRODUCIBILITY HEADER. one-row-per-state-year. Every USD = read directly in-session from the cited keyless document (pdftotext/HTML extraction). null = routes-tried-no-capture (TX/LA), never a placeholder. value_kind explains the budget basis (adopted-act vs GAA vs recommended vs county-spending grain). county_allocation_table_available: OH=True (LSC series gives per-county state-MH USD for all 88 counties), PA/MI=partial (county grain inside county-submitted plans / CMHSP contract letters), TN=False keyless (tn.gov bot-block), MA/NY/MO/OK=False (no state-published by-county USD table). Per-capita: OH FY2025 Hamilton = 18,505,260 / 827,359 pop ≈ $22.4 state-MH per capita (both figures verbatim from same LSC pdf). Built 2026-11-22 by build_state_mh_series_v1.py; workdir _stmh/ holds all source PDFs+txt for re-run.
